testCases.title: A11Y - WCAG 2.1 AA Keyboard Navigation & Focus Hierarchy in Category Tree View
preconditions: InvenTree web frontend running in Chromium via Playwright
Category tree loaded with root and multi-level child categories

steps.action: Navigate to Part Management view and press Tab until focus reaches the Category Tree container
steps.expectedResult: Focus lands on first tree node with a visible, high-contrast focus indicator (contrast ratio >= 3:1)

steps.action: Use Arrow Down and Arrow Up keys to navigate between sibling category nodes
steps.expectedResult: Focus moves sequentially without requiring mouse interaction; active descendant or roving tabindex is maintained

steps.action: Press Arrow Right on a collapsed parent node, then Arrow Left on an expanded node
steps.expectedResult: Arrow Right expands child categories; Arrow Left collapses them; aria-expanded reflects boolean state ('true'/'false')

steps.action: Press Enter or Space on a selected node
steps.expectedResult: Category is selected; parts list updates to show category parts; zero keyboard traps encountered

postConditions: Tree view is 100% navigable via keyboard alone without relying on pointer devices

testCases.title: A11Y - WCAG 2.1 AA Dialog Focus Trap, Escape Key & ARIA Modality in Create Part Modal
preconditions: Web frontend operational in Playwright browser context

steps.action: Trigger 'Add Part' button in UI via keyboard Enter key
steps.expectedResult: Modal opens; focus automatically shifts to the first interactive field (Part Name input) or the modal container

steps.action: Assert modal DOM attributes and ARIA roles
steps.expectedResult: Modal element contains role='dialog', aria-modal='true', and an accessible name via aria-labelledby or aria-label

steps.action: Tab through all form fields to the final element (Cancel button) and press Tab once more
steps.expectedResult: Focus wraps around to the first focusable element inside the modal; background page content is inert and unreachable
Modal closes cleanly; focus is restored back to the original 'Add Part' trigger button

postConditions: Dialog maintains strict focus containment and predictable restoration upon exit

testCases.title: A11Y - Automated Axe-Core Full Page Accessibility Sweep on Part Views
preconditions: @axe-core/playwright test integration initialized in test harness
Part Index and Create Part pages rendered

steps.action: Execute AxeBuilder audit on the Part Management catalogue view with category sidebar expanded
steps.expectedResult: Zero violations with impact 'critical' or 'serious'; color contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for standard text

steps.action: Execute AxeBuilder audit on the open 'Create Part' modal dialog
steps.expectedResult: Zero form label violations (all inputs have associated <label> elements or aria-label); zero missing landmark warnings

postConditions: Axe audit report passes with 100% compliance on automated WCAG 2.1 Level AA rules

testCases.title: A11Y - Screen Reader Error Announcements & Live Regions on Validation Failures
preconditions: Create Part modal open in browser
Form validation triggered with blank mandatory name field

steps.action: Submit 'Create Part' form with empty required fields
steps.expectedResult: Form validation triggers; invalid input element marked with aria-invalid='true' and linked to error text via aria-describedby

steps.action: Inspect dynamic error summary or alert notification banner in the DOM
steps.expectedResult: Error message container has role='alert' or aria-live='assertive', allowing assistive technologies to announce the failure immediately

postConditions: Assistive technology users receive clear, real-time auditory notifications of submission errors
